description: Reddit search API: find Reddit posts and discussions by keyword, optionally within a subreddit, sorted by relevance, new or top over a timeframe. Returns title, subreddit, permalink, score, comment count, timestamp and post text. Use for community sentiment, product feedback, brand mentions, trend and market research — what are people saying on Reddit about X. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: agentbit.reddit_search
title: Reddit Search
